searchText.title: Keyword searches
searchText.description: Topics to search across project titles, abstracts and terms, one per line ("crispr gene editing", "alzheimer biomarkers"). Leave empty to browse by the filters below only.

organizations.title: Institutions
organizations.description: Limit to specific grantee institutions, one per line ("STANFORD UNIVERSITY", "MAYO CLINIC"). Applied to every search.

principalInvestigators.title: Principal investigators
principalInvestigators.description: Limit to grants led by these researchers, one name per line ("Doudna", "Jennifer Doudna").

states.title: States
states.description: Limit to institutions in these US states, one two-letter code per line ("CA", "MA").

fiscalYears.title: Fiscal years
fiscalYears.description: Limit to these fiscal years, one per line ("2025", "2024"). Leave empty for all years.

minAwardUsd.title: Minimum award ($)
minAwardUsd.description: Only grants with total funding of at least this many dollars. 0 = no minimum.

includeAbstract.title: Include abstract
includeAbstract.description: Include each grant's abstract text. Turn off for smaller rows when you only need the funding facts.

maxPerQuery.title: Grants per search
maxPerQuery.description: How many grants to return per keyword search (or, if no keywords, in total for the filters).

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
